Otian AI · Meet Archie

Don’t rent your agent. Own it. Yours to shape & yours to keep.

Archie is a desktop app that runs your AI agent on the computer you already have. You tell the agent a job the way you would tell a person, and it does that job on your schedule. It is free on your own AI account: 20 jobs a day, no card.

Calendar Manager · 9:12 am

Ask in the words you would say out loud.

Archie reads your calendar on its own. It proposes the exact change and applies it only after you approve it in a later message.

A routine running on its own cannot apply a calendar change at all. It reports what it would make instead of making it.

Email Manager · 1:40 pm

Archie drafts the reply. You send it, or you don’t.

Nothing leaves your account until you send it or set a time.

Every email feature refuses to run on the free starter credits; connect an AI account of your own and it starts.

Where your words go

Your conversations go to your AI provider. Not to us.

A message laps from your chat app to your agent to the AI company you picked, and back. Anything heading for your mail or calendar stops at the gate and waits for you.

Starter credits and included AI reach Anthropic through our server without being kept. Your own key bypasses it from each agent’s next start.

Keys in your computer’s password store No analytics service in the app Add-ons are text, not code Nothing connects until you connect it
Check every claim yourself, in 10 minutes →
What Archie takes off you · 4:15 pm

None of it is hard. It is just spread across everything you own.

Four of 160 add-ons, all included, each under its real name. Say the next job in a sentence and Archie writes the routine.

Cannot spend money or buy anything Connects to no bank

Add-ons with routines run on their own schedule, and those runs are a real part of a heavy month’s AI bill. What that costs, measured →

Say the job in your own words and see which one does it →
Overnight · 2:00 am

Archie works while you sleep.

A routine set for seven in the morning arrives at seven, even if the computer was asleep. Archie asks your Mac to wake a few minutes before, runs it, and lets it go back to sleep.

The next morning · 7:00 am

You wake up to what your agent already did.

What could be finished is finished. What needs a decision is drafted and waiting for you.

Scroll through one day
Not only handing over

Ask your agent what you would ask any AI chat.

Not all of it is work to hand over. Ask how to word a hard email, or what to cook with what is in the fridge, and your agent answers the way any AI chat you have used does. Same conversation, so the asking and the doing are not in two places.

It is a model, so it is wrong sometimes, and the app says so under the box you type in.

Before a reply goes out

Your agent is not wrong. It just isn’t you.

An estimate · 60 days in

One customer gets two to three hours back, every day.

He runs a business where failed credit card payments used to mean writing to customers one by one. Sixty days ago he handed that job, and a growing list of others, to an agent he named Coleman.

I would estimate that I am saving two to three hours per day on ordinary tasks that Coleman now handles for me, including bulk emails, building reports, and generating email responses.
